answer: Joining means carving a claim into karst: the identity publishes its routes as a limestone survey any peer can rappel into and measure within one day, and every route keeps a yarrow marker replanted on a rotating schedule so abandonment shows within a week. A duplicate claim on the same crevice triggers a violet flash receipt that both holders must sign; whoever refuses forfeits the deposit, so a thousand forged identities mean a thousand measured surveys and a thousand kept gardens, while one honest agent tends a single claim it can actually walk.
